question: Which reality star just publicly torched his former castmate?
story: A Love Island winner just told his former castmate to keep his name out of his mouth, and it is getting messy. Here is the setup. Kordell Beckham won season six of Love Island USA back in 2024 with his girlfriend Serena. His castmates JaNa and Kenny did not last, splitting about a year ago. This week, according to E! News, Kenny went on a podcast and got emotional, reportedly claiming JaNa and her friends plotted against him after the breakup. He also said Kordell was the only cast member who ever reached out to him. Kordell saw that and was not having it. On July twentieth he posted that Kenny lied the entire time, denied ever reaching out, and told him, quote, keep my name out your mouth. He signed off shouting out JaNa, calling her his sister for life. So much for island love.
